page.overview:
Who is Kaneki?

In order to retain his reputation against rival companies, Kaneki pushed forward a dangerous project in one of his chemical plants, even when warned of the high risk. This resulted in an explosion that killed many people. He successfully pinned the blame of the explosion on the deceased project developer, Mikazuki Amaashi.

Kaneki is a rather mischievous old man who does whatever he wants, taking advantage of his status. He absolutely does not feel the torment of conscience for the death of a girl at his enterprise, blaming her for everything. However, behind his power and money, Kaneki is unable to hide his cowardice, which he showed when the Rain Killer attacked, begging him for mercy. He is able to admit some mistakes, as he accepted the help of Kōtarō Fūma and Team 7 in his security, whom he had previously driven off, relying on his own bodyguards.

Kaneki is an older, stocky, short man with black eyes that he almost always keeps closed and a round, wrinkled face. He has long grey hair that has a huge bald patch in the centre of his head. Kaneki is wearing grey pants, a dark grey shirt, and a purple kimono.

As the president of a large company that competes with the Kaminarimon Company, Kaneki has considerable power. He allows himself to refuse the help of the police and even be rude to its leader, and also retains a huge number of bodyguards.
